definitions.explanation: The arrangement of troops, players, or personnel in strategic positions. Originally a military term, now commonly used in sports, business, and politics to describe how people or resources are positioned.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{布陣|ふじん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{臨|のぞ}む→臨む：29038_nozomu⟧。
examples.english: To go in with a new lineup.

examples.japanese: ⟦{監督|かんとく}→監督：00185_kantoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{守備|しゅび}→守備：15509_shubi⟧⟦{重視|じゅうし}→重視：03341_juushi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{布陣|ふじん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{敷|し}いた→敷く：00366_shiku⟧。
examples.english: The manager set up a defense-focused formation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{新|しん}⟦プロジェクト→プロジェクト：06764_purojekuto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}けて→向ける：02306_mukeru⟧{精鋭|せいえい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}めた→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧{布陣|ふじん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{整|ととの}えた→整える：04259_totonoeru⟧。
examples.english: The president assembled an elite lineup for the new project.

notes: Common collocations: {布陣|ふじん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{敷|し}く→敷く：00366_shiku⟧ (to set up a formation), {布陣|ふじん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{整|ととの}える→整える：04259_totonoeru⟧ (to arrange a lineup), ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{布陣|ふじん} (a new formation/lineup). Frequently used in sports commentary, especially soccer (4-4-2⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{布陣|ふじん}, a 4-4-2 formation) and in business/political reporting about personnel arrangements. A homophone of ⟦{夫人|ふじん}→夫人：03597_fujin⟧ (wife) and ⟦{婦人|ふじん}→婦人：01658_fujin⟧ (woman), but distinct in meaning and kanji.
